pages.title: Irradiation Chamber
pages.text: Holds a target in the neutron flux of a source until nuclei catch neutrons and become something else.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Needs a neutron source in its catalyst slot (Radium Salt, or for the strongest flux Californium-252), never used up.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 2 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Californium-252 Neutron Source, Plutonium-239 Pellet, Spent Fuel Rod, Technetium-99m Vial, Tritium.
